description_ru: Делювиальные отложения. Суглинки, супеси, пески с дресвой, щебнем, галькой, глыбами (до 5 м)
note: GGK-200/2 O-57-XXX (sop. Ostraya), East Kamchatka series, Quaternary map 2nd ed., RASTER = geokniga 1974x2548 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px; no full-resolution scan on geokniga); units from the separate legend JPG o-57-xxxql.jpg; fills = MAP tints: legend swatch -> map full RGB affine fitted on 15 pairs sampled inside labelled polygons (median residual 2.3 dE), paired units take their own map tint, all refined on the face (r 4, cap 5 dE); vLHss2 and dlH dropped (no polygon on the face; their tints caught river channels and the red ice-flow arrows / fault lines); extraction: corners = inner neatline edge fitted along the four sides (34 m/px preview), --no-snap, --restrict ICE to the Shiveluch glacier zone in the S (white glacier / blue firn symbols; elsewhere white = label boxes, lakes), --thin-units cH;dH:2 (red fault lines and ice-flow arrows read as colluvium); the red grid of end-moraine ridges on gIII4 is left to the median/majority filter (stays T)
